news.headline: Delcath Systems Extends Rally to Fresh 52-Week High of $17.42
news.summary: DCTH continued grinding higher after the Q2 beat, touching a new 52-week high of $17.42 on August 18, within a 52-week range of $8.12-$17.42. Sell-side coverage stayed uniformly bullish, with BTIG at $21 (from $17, August 6), H.C. Wainwright at $32 (from $30, August 7), and upgrades from Wall Street Zen and Zacks, pushing the consensus 12-month target into the low-to-mid $20s across five Buy/Strong Buy ratings and no Sell ratings.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Amends Bylaws to Designate Delaware Courts as Exclusive Forum
news.summary: The board amended and restated Delcath's bylaws so that Delaware's Court of Chancery is the exclusive forum for internal corporate claims and U.S. federal courts for Securities Act claims. This is a routine governance update for a Delaware-incorporated company, recommended by the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee and not tied to any pending matter.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Presents at Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference in Boston
news.summary: Management presented to institutional investors in Boston five days after the Q2 beat, using the slot to reinforce the HEPZATO KIT commercial-ramp story and the center-activation roadmap. Investor outreach at growth conferences has been a consistent part of the post-approval narrative build.

news.headline: Q2 Call: mCRC Phase 2 Now Screening at 13 Centers, Breast Cancer Program Advancing
news.summary: On the Q2 call management said the company-sponsored Phase 2 trial in liver-dominant metastatic colorectal cancer now has 13 centers actively screening, with recruitment improving after site additions and specialized training. Management also flagged independent ESMO Breast Cancer 2026 data showing a 60% hepatic partial response rate with percutaneous hepatic perfusion in heavily pretreated liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer, and reiterated that Europe should grow only in the single digits in 2026 while CHEMOSAT reimbursement stays unresolved.

news.headline: Delcath Reports Q2 2026 Results: $29.1M Revenue Beats Estimates, Raises FY Guidance to $104M-$108M
news.summary: Total revenue rose to $29.1M from $24.2M a year earlier (HEPZATO KIT $27.1M, CHEMOSAT $2.0M) on roughly 30% HEPZATO volume growth, with gross margin expanding to 90% from 86%, net income of $2.7M, EPS of $0.07 versus a consensus loss of $0.09, and $5.7M of operating cash flow. Delcath ended the quarter with $95.9M in cash and investments and no debt, activated two more sites to reach 31 active treatment centers, and raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $104M-$108M while reiterating positive adjusted EBITDA for the year; the stock jumped over 20% on the print.

news.headline: Delcath Announces First Patient Dosed in Phase 2 HEPZATO Trial for Liver-Dominant Metastatic Breast Cancer
news.summary: The first patient was dosed at the European Institute of Oncology in Milan in the roughly 90-patient randomized Phase 2 trial (PHP-MBC-202, NCT06875128), testing HEPZATO plus standard of care in HER2-negative liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer across US and EU sites. It is the company's key pipeline expansion beyond uveal melanoma into a far larger addressable indication.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: The next quarterly report is expected in early-to-mid November 2026 based on prior-year timing (Q3 2025 was reported November 4, 2025); no exact 2026 date has been announced yet as of August 21. It is the first checkpoint on whether HEPZATO volume growth and center activations are tracking the raised full-year guidance.

catalysts.label: 37 active HEPZATO treatment centers by year-end
catalysts.detail: Delcath exited Q2 2026 with 31 active HEPZATO KIT centers after two activations in the quarter, and management reiterated it is on track to add roughly six more to reach 37 by year-end. Center count is the most direct driver of near-term revenue, so the pace of the final activations is the key operational metric.

catalysts.label: FY2026 guidance of $104M-$108M and positive adjusted EBITDA
catalysts.detail: Raised guidance implies at least 28% HEPZATO volume growth over 2025 with gross margin around 90%. Management also guided to positive adjusted EBITDA for the full year, which would mark the transition to a self-funding commercial model on a $95.9M cash position with no debt.

catalysts.label: mCRC Phase 2 enrollment progress
catalysts.detail: The company-sponsored Phase 2 of HEPZATO in liver-dominant metastatic colorectal cancer now has 13 centers actively screening, with recruitment improving after site additions and investigator training. Enrollment milestones and eventual data would open the largest liver-dominant indication in the pipeline.

catalysts.label: European CHEMOSAT reimbursement decisions
catalysts.detail: European revenue stayed at just $2.0M in Q2 and management guides to only single-digit growth in 2026 unless reimbursement improves in key markets. Any national reimbursement win would re-rate the currently near-breakeven European segment.

catalysts.label: Breast cancer Phase 2 enrollment and data
catalysts.detail: The roughly 90-patient randomized Phase 2 in HER2-negative liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer (PHP-MBC-202) began dosing in July 2026 at the European Institute of Oncology in Milan and is enrolling across US and EU sites. Full enrollment and first efficacy readouts are the next major pipeline catalysts, supported by independent ESMO retrospective data showing a 60% hepatic partial response rate.

pulse: Delcath remains in the strongest stretch of its commercial story: Q2 2026 revenue of $29.1M beat estimates, gross margin reached 90%, the company posted $2.7M of net income and $5.7M of operating cash flow, and full-year guidance was lifted to $104M-$108M with positive adjusted EBITDA expected, all on $95.9M of cash and no debt. In the two weeks since, no new business-moving news has emerged -- the stock has simply extended its post-earnings rally to a fresh 52-week high of $17.42 (August 18), with sell-side targets clustered in the low-to-mid $20s (BTIG $21, H.C. Wainwright $32) and no Sell ratings outstanding. The next tests are purely execution -- getting from 31 to 37 active HEPZATO centers by year-end and validating guidance at the not-yet-scheduled Q3 report expected in November -- while the main risks stay a single-product US revenue base, a European CHEMOSAT franchise still stuck near breakeven on reimbursement, and pipeline optionality in colorectal and breast cancer that is years from data.
